Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the chapter introduction, driver licensing and responsibilities and visibility resolve to the first selected page, maneuvering space, stopping, acceleration, downgrades, slipstream and hazardous materials to the second, emergency equipment and the start of towing to the third, hitches, load and equipment to the fourth, the motorcycle introduction to the fifth, size to the sixth, lane position to the seventh, intersections to the eighth, following distance to the ninth, and passing and licensing to the tenth.

Confidence: high across the section; every rule is printed directly on its page. One source-form caution: on the first and second pages the words a crash and two letters of ensure and the comma after safety are set in separate text runs that interleave with the paragraphs in the snapshot's text layer, so those sentences were reassembled in reading order.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
